# Phase 0 results (generated by phase0.py; snapshot to 2026-10-02T08:13:56.047Z)

Method: position history from `snapshots.position` (290 live snapshots, median gap 2.6 min), trades priced at the tournament mid; FIFO lots. Trades inside one snapshot interval net out, so turnover is a lower bound (cross-check from fills.csv below). 'Toward Polymarket' = bought where mid < reference or sold where mid > reference by more than 0.5c at the snapshot before the trade.

## b. Realised vs unrealised; account vs liquidation value
- Account value 101,509 (exchange mark), so P&L since the open +1,509.
- Realised on closed lots (at mid): +154. Unrealised on open lots (mid now - mid at entry): -42. Residual (spread captured vs mid at fill, fees, mark differences): +1,398.
- Liquidation haircut (longs to best bid, shorts to best ask, top of book only, no depth): 428 -> liquidation value about 101,081 (+1,081 vs the 100k start).
- Value of the open book if every leg moved to Polymarket (sum pos*(ref-mid)): +1,839; if the gap never closes that is not earned.
- Worst-case settlement loss 32,418 (32% of account); locked in orders 32,981.

## c. Turnover and holding time
- Shares entered 321,639, exited 243,439: exits/entries = 0.76 (capital: entered 187,902, exited 135,671, 0.72).
- Cross-check: fills.csv has 1813 fills, 587,434 shares; snapshot-netted entries+exits = 565,078 (96% of fill volume).
- Open lots: capital-weighted median age 8.8 h; capital older than 6 h 69%, 12 h 18%, 24 h 0% (tournament was 16.2 h old at the snapshot, so >24 h cannot exist yet).
- Closed lots: share-weighted median holding time 0.23 h.

## d. Does size follow the gap (the Kelly point)
- Across 159 open positions: corr(signed position, gap at entry) = +0.33; corr(capital, |gap at entry|) = +0.27.
- With the gap now: corr(signed position, gap) = +0.38; corr(capital, |gap|) = +0.33.

## Verdict (added by hand, Finisher 2a): PARTLY CONFIRMED
- Confirmed, the bias: 76% of open position capital was entered toward Polymarket (11% against, 12% no clear gap); by the gap now 77% vs 3%. Toward lots stick: 65% of toward-entered capital has exited vs 85% of against-entered.
- Confirmed, size follows the gap: mean capital per position 1,194 at gaps of 5c+ vs 175-434 below; 49 positions entered at 2c+ hold 52% of capital. Five of the eight biggest sit at ~2,000 = `kelly_max_market_frac` (2% of the account): quarter Kelly is at its cap there.
- Confirmed, stuck: open capital has a median age of 8.8 h (69% older than 6 h) while closed lots lasted a median 14 min. Gaps on the big positions widened since entry (e.g. Rep U.S. House -3.2c -> -5.5c): no convergence so far. Worst case 32% of the account.
- Not confirmed at this snapshot: "the gain is mostly marks". +1,509 = realised +154, unrealised -42, spread capture and other +1,398; top-of-book liquidation haircut 428. The open book carries a +1,839 bet on the gaps closing, not yet in the account value. The +26% day-one figure is not in the data: the day-one account value double-counted locked cash (snapshot README).
- Not in this snapshot: 90% of capital in positions (51% here at 08:14 UTC, after a night of reduce-only; the afternoon state is later than the data). 14% of position capital is the U.S. Senate pair (long both legs, 7,335 each): locked, neutral, not a Polymarket bet.
